listing.name: Absolute Movement
listing.summary: Toggleable setting that changes the player ship's movement from ship relative to screen-absolute.
listing.aiSummary: Changes player ship movement from ship-relative to screen-absolute, allowing controls to move the ship towards screen directions regardless of heading.

description:
Toggleable setting that changes the player ship's movement from ship relative to screen-absolute. In other words, holding down W (by default) will move your ship towards the top of your screen (or 'North', if you prefer), regardless of whatever heading your ship may be holding.

While active this completely overrides vanilla movement for the player's ship so there will be quirks; generally speaking though, it works much more fluidly than the hidden "CardinalMode" vanilla setting.

By default W moves the ship up, A to the left, S down, and D to the right. The mode is toggled on and off with M.

Your strafe keybinds must be the same as the mod's left/right keys - unintended behavior may result if you don't follow this advice.

aiDescription: Changes player ship movement from ship-relative to screen-absolute, allowing controls to move the ship towards screen directions regardless of heading. This mode completely overrides vanilla movement for the player's ship while active, offering a more fluid experience than the hidden vanilla CardinalMode setting. The mode is toggled on and off with the M key, and configuration options are available through a Lunaconfig menu.

changelog.1.0.8a: - No longer blocks the usage of the movement keys in the main menu for things like assigning lunasetting keycodes.
changelog.1.0.8:
- Fixed AM mode returning to vanilla movement when using ship systems that force acceleration but leave turning and strafing intact (e.g. SWP's Maximum Drive on the Victory).
- Added a lunasetting that allows combat to begin with AM enabled.
